state_projection_flag: PHX_AUTO_PROJECT_ACTIONS=true or POST body { apply:true } with admin role

contracts.title: Buyer lead request
contracts.description: Creates a buyer request packet to route against generated city/category lead rules.

contracts.title: Owner claim or correction
contracts.description: Creates an owner verification packet without granting automatic verification.

contracts.title: Profile enrichment patch
contracts.description: Stages copy/contact/category improvements for admin review before seed publication.

contracts.title: Suppression or duplicate removal request
contracts.description: Stages a suppression patch for seed/businesses/suppressions.json instead of pretending to delete live static records.

contracts.title: AE account note
contracts.description: Stores AE outreach notes and next steps for the upstream-auth CRM layer.

contracts.title: Verification decision
contracts.description: Records claim review decisions. It never auto-verifies without an explicit admin decision.

contracts.title: Claim lifecycle status update
contracts.description: Applies an admin-reviewed claim lifecycle status to the runtime state projection.

contracts.title: Lead lifecycle status update
contracts.description: Moves a buyer lead through new, contacted, routed, won, lost, or archived runtime states.

contracts.title: Admin listing patch
contracts.description: Stages an approved listing patch in runtime state before seed/data publication.

contracts.title: Suppression draft apply
contracts.description: Creates a suppression draft that can be exported into seed/businesses/suppressions.json.

contracts.title: AE account stage update
contracts.description: Moves a seeded account through the AE activation pipeline.

contracts.title: Sponsor or exposure product intent
contracts.description: Captures paid exposure interest without claiming billing is complete.

contracts.title: 0S first-month customer public business landing
contracts.description: Queues the free Valley Verified public business landing/posting promised to qualified MetrAIyux 0S customers after their first paid month. It never publishes without review and does not require an upgrade.

contracts.title: Owner contact log
contracts.description: Records owner outreach attempts and follow-up tasks.

contracts.title: Payment provider event
contracts.description: Records a verified payment provider webhook event without automatically granting paid placement.

contracts.title: Exposure activation decision
contracts.description: Admin-approved activation of a paid exposure product after verified payment.

contracts.title: Quote request intake
contracts.description: Creates a structured quote request that can be ranked, routed, and followed by AEs without creating fake lead delivery claims.

contracts.title: Lead route decision
contracts.description: Records which businesses should receive or be considered for a quote/lead and why.

contracts.title: AE account assignment
contracts.description: Assigns an account or territory task to an AE while preserving upstream auth ownership.

contracts.title: Owner message draft
contracts.description: Stores an owner outreach message draft or approved message intent. Provider delivery is separate.

contracts.title: Notification delivery event
contracts.description: Records email/SMS/webhook delivery receipts without claiming an external provider succeeded without proof.

contracts.title: Revenue attribution event
contracts.description: Attributes revenue to product, AE, business, and lead paths after verified payment or admin-approved revenue event.

contracts.title: Admin review decision
contracts.description: Stores approval/rejection decisions for queued actions and state projection history.
